messages:
maya: Quick sync — AMS region rollout milestone check. On track for Fri cutover? cc @linh @kevin
linh: FYI the routing policy PR is up (eng-platform#421). Waiting on kevin for the final rules for cross-region fallback.
kevin: Taking a look now. My main question: do we prefer latency-based routing or strict locality for initial canary?
sarah: Product prefers locality for GDPR customers in EU for the first two weeks, then relax to latency-based after validation.
maya: OK note: data residency docs must be published before canary. @jose can you confirm legal signoff ETA?
jose: Legal just finished review — signoff granted as of today. I uploaded the policy PDF to the runbook: https://company.internal/runbooks/ams-data-residency.pdf :tada:
maya: Great. @kevin once you update PR #421 pls tag @linh for the network-specific ACL checks. Also need a small config snippet in infra repo.
kevin: Will push patch today. Quick snippet I plan to add in infra-configs/regions/ams.yaml:
```
routing:
  primary: eu-central-1
  fallback_policy: strict_locality
  canary: true
  canary_traffic: 0.05
```
linh: That looks fine. I'll run the acl test once it's in. Can you also include the header rewrite for proxied requests? See my comment on the PR.
maya: Ops question — do we need on-call rotation changes during cutover? Ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window set for 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pager duty unchanged.
kevin: pinging @sarah for final acceptance criteria so I can merge after CI passes. Also requesting one more CR from @linh (network) and @jose (compliance hooks).
sarah: Acceptance: 1) end-to-end smoke success <1s p50; 2) no data stored outside EU for residency-tagged requests; 3) rollbacks script tested.
linh: I can CR after CI. I'll run the simulated failover test in staging tomorrow morning and post results here.
kevin: PR 421 -> updated, CI green, added header rewrite and test. Linking: https://git.internal/eng-platform/pulls/421
maya: Nice. @deploy-bot can you start a canary deployment tomorrow at 02:15 UTC once we confirm ACLs?
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 2026-03-21 02:15 UTC. Notifying eng-platform and eng-sre channels.
jose: Compliance note: keep audit logs retention at 7 years for residency customers — update is in the runbook.
linh: Staging failover test done: session affinity preserved, fallback to backup region succeeded, latency within expected bounds. Posting logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T09:12:03Z] proxy: routed to ams-primary (p50=42ms)
[2026-03-19T09:12:10Z] proxy: primary unreachable, routed to eu-backup (p50=65ms)
```
kevin: Thanks. Merging PR now. Will monitor canary and post metrics.
maya: Owners & next steps:
- kevin: merge PR + trigger canary
- linh: ACL verification + failover runbook update
- jose: publish compliance summary in runbook
- sarah: monitor product acceptance criteria during canary
- maya: coordinate post-canary retro and sign-off
Please add anything I missed. :+1:
kevin: I added a short rollback script at infra-scripts/rollbacks/ams_rollback.sh. Tagging for review.
linh: I'll do a quick CR on the rollback script, then we should be good.
sarah: If canary passes, product is ready to flip to full routing next Tue.
maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll update the calendar invite and runbook after merge.
